headline_hook: Anthropic Drops $100M on Partners While 1M Context Goes Free and Codex Gets GPT-5.3

pick_of_the_day.thesis: MCP's tool-loading overhead reveals that the industry standardized on an integration protocol before solving the economics — and CLI-based alternatives cutting 96-99% of token waste suggest the real MCP killer isn't a better protocol, it's not using one at all.

model_literacy.relevance: Claude's 1M context going GA sounds like a solved problem, but research consistently shows models degrade on needle-in-haystack tasks well before hitting their stated limit. Understanding the gap between advertised and effective context is critical for anyone designing RAG-vs-long-context architectures.

items.title: Claude Doubles Usage Off-Peak Through March 27
items.angle: Anthropic is buying weekend and evening adoption with a 2x usage boost across all Claude surfaces — a growth play that signals off-peak capacity is going unused
items.key_fact: 2x usage on weekends and off-peak weekday hours through March 27, across claude.ai, Cowork, and Claude Code

items.title: 1M Context Window Goes GA for Claude — No Extra Cost
items.angle: The long-context price premium era is over — Anthropic bundles 1M tokens into existing Max/Team/Enterprise plans, making context a commodity rather than an upsell
items.key_fact: 1M context now GA for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, included in Max/Team/Enterprise at no extra cost

items.title: Anthropic Commits $100M to Claude Partner Network
items.angle: The enterprise AI war has shifted from model quality to distribution — this $100M bet says Anthropic believes integrations and channel partnerships will determine who wins the enterprise
items.key_fact: $100M investment into partner ecosystem for Claude integrations

items.title: GPT-5.3-Codex Lands in OpenAI's Codex Product
items.angle: OpenAI pairs its dedicated coding model with its agentic coding environment — a direct answer to Claude Code's Opus integration that makes the coding agent war a two-product race
items.key_fact: GPT-5.3-Codex now available inside OpenAI's Codex agentic coding tool

items.title: Qwen3.5-122B Delivers Frontier Knowledge at Mid-Tier Cost
items.angle: Alibaba's latest MoE model uses only 10B active parameters out of 122B total, making frontier-class reasoning affordable — already at 438K downloads
items.key_fact: 122B total parameters, 10B active; 438K downloads on HuggingFace

items.title: Gemini Brings Multi-Step Reasoning to Google Maps
items.angle: One of the clearest examples of LLMs improving a product billions already use — Maps now reasons across 300M+ community photos to answer complex natural-language queries
items.key_fact: Reasoning across 300M+ community photos and reviews for complex queries

items.title: Claude Code Now Starts from Your Phone
items.angle: Remote-control coding sessions from mobile turns dead time into productive time — start a refactor from the couch, review on the train
items.key_fact: Spawn and manage Claude Code sessions on your laptop from your phone

items.title: GLM-OCR Hits 2.6M Downloads as the Go-To Document Extraction Model
items.angle: Zhipu AI's dedicated OCR model is trending hard on HuggingFace — if you're doing document extraction, benchmark this against your current pipeline

items.title: NVIDIA NeMo Retriever Moves Beyond Semantic Similarity to Agentic Search
items.angle: The model actively plans and executes multi-step search strategies — a practical upgrade for anyone hitting the ceiling with vanilla vector search
items.key_fact: Agentic retrieval with multi-step search planning, not just semantic similarity

items.title: MCP's Hidden Token Tax: Why CLI Beats Protocol
items.angle: Every connected MCP server loads ALL tool definitions every turn — tools like mcp2cli claim 96-99% token savings by converting to on-demand CLI commands
items.key_fact: 96-99% token savings by replacing MCP servers with on-demand CLI commands

items.title: Post-RAG Retrieval: Hybrid Search and Agentic Patterns
items.angle: Turbopuffer's Simon Eskildsen breaks down how retrieval architecture needs to evolve beyond naive RAG — covering hybrid search and database design for agentic retrieval
items.key_fact: Covers hybrid search, agentic retrieval patterns, and database design for post-RAG era

items.title: Prompt Injection Meets Real Credentials: Your Agent's Threat Model
items.angle: If you're deploying agents with tool access and real credentials, this breakdown of web-browsing prompt injection attacks is required reading
items.key_fact: Detailed attack taxonomy for AI agents browsing the web with real credentials

items.title: GPT-5.4 Tops CursorBench While Using Fewer Tokens
items.angle: OpenAI is optimizing for cost-per-correct-completion — the metric that actually matters for coding agents — not just raw accuracy
items.key_fact: Leads CursorBench on correctness with more efficient token usage than competitors

items.angle: A new benchmark evaluates whether frontier agents can handle the full post-training pipeline — the work that makes models actually useful

items.angle: Liquid AI's LFM2-VL via WebGPU proves meaningful vision models can run client-side — no server, no latency, full privacy
